title: "T2D complications — figure report"
subtitle: "Prevalence, laboratory associations, biomarker ROC and logistic regression"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: hide
    df_print: paged
params:
  data_path: ""     # ruta a un RDS limpio; vacío = autodetectar (real -> demo)
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, dpi = 110)
root <- normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "config.R"))) root <- getwd()
source(file.path(root, "R", "load_data.R")); source(file.path(root, "R", "plots.R"))
if (nzchar(params$data_path)) Sys.setenv(TD2_APP_DATA = params$data_path)
dat <- load_td2_data(root); df <- dat$data
```

```{r banner, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (dat$synthetic) cat("> **Synthetic demo data.** Values are randomly generated, not patients; nothing here has clinical meaning. Knit again after running `01_limpieza.R` on the real dataset to produce the real report (do not publish it without ethics/data-governance approval).\n")
```

Source: `r basename(dat$path)` — n = `r nrow(df)` patients. Generated `r format(Sys.Date())` with `r R.version.string`.

## 1. Prevalence

```{r prev}
plot_prevalence(df)
knitr::kable(prevalence_table(df)[, c("label", "n", "N", "pct", "lo", "hi")], digits = 1,
             col.names = c("Condition", "n", "N", "%", "95% CI low", "95% CI high"))
```

## 2. Population

```{r pop}
plot_age_pyramid(df)
plot_bmi_by_sex(df)
plot_ckd_stages(df)
```

## 3. Complications

```{r comp}
plot_complications_by_sex(df)
plot_burden(df)
```

## 4. Laboratory associations

```{r labs, fig.width=6.5}
plot_lab_by_outcome(df, "TFG_CKD_EPI", "ERC")
plot_lab_by_outcome(df, "Acido_Urico", "ERC")
plot_lab_by_outcome(df, "Glucosa", "Retinopatia")
```

```{r cor, fig.height=7, fig.width=9}
plot_corr_heatmap(df)
```

## 5. Biomarker ROC

```{r roc, fig.height=6}
for (o in roc_outcomes) print(plot_roc_multi(df, o))
plot_auc_heatmap(df)
```

```{r roctab}
rt <- roc_table(df)
knitr::kable(dplyr::transmute(rt, Biomarker = unname(lab_dict[biomarker]), Complication = unname(outcome_dict[outcome]),
  AUC = round(auc, 3), `95% CI` = sprintf("%.3f–%.3f", lo, hi), Cutoff = round(cutoff, 2),
  Sens = round(sens, 3), Spec = round(spec, 3), Interpretation = interpretation))
```

## 6. Logistic regression (backward AIC)

```{r reg, fig.height=4}
for (o in reg_outcomes) {
  f <- fit_logistic(df, o)
  print(plot_forest(f, paste("Predictors of", tolower(unname(outcome_dict[o])))))
}
```
